what: Text hides beneath its own line mask, then when it enters the screen each line rises from below (70%) in .5 seconds at .1 second intervals (once only). With split: none the lines are not split and the text rises as one block of children. Distance, length, interval and curve are options — Brand A uses 110% at 1.5 beats, Brand B’s hero words use 105% with a slight overshoot over 1.05 seconds, Brand C’s intro text uses 102% over 1.4 seconds expo.out, and Brand D uses 115% tilted 3° with blur over 1.05 seconds power3.out at .08 second intervals.

options.split: lines (default) — split by line · words — split by word · none — child block as a whole · chars — per character inside a line mask (Brand wordmark)
options.y: Rise distance (%), default 70 — when given, uses only a cover panel with no blur
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or 0.16,1,0.3,1, default power2.inOut
options.rotate: Tilt (degrees) that unwinds as it rises, default 0 — rotates around the top left of the row
options.fade: “true” makes it light up together from blur (0) even when y is given (default: with y, only via the mask)
options.toggle: If true, not just once — when you scroll back above the trigger position it plays back in reverse (from the last chunk), like the footer wordmark each time you go back and forth
options.fit: Reference font size (px) for stretching the length by text size — if given, the length = dur × (glyph px ÷ fit)^0.2. The bigger the title, the slower it rises (Brand 14)
options.blur: Blur that clears while rising (px), default 0 — reference value 12
options.mask: 「none」 means words and lines rise visible without a cover (Brand site — the default is with a cover)
options.widen: Starting horizontal multiplier that shrinks as it rises, default 1 — corner-panel-stack-studio page large title 1.12 (the start of the text is the axis)
options.tilt: Tilt where the front of the line leans down (rotateX degrees). It rises in perspective (default 600px) and stands at 0. Default 0 · brand −45
options.origin: Rotation pivot for rotate (transform-origin), default “top left” — the ride-plus-a Hero text uses “50% 50%” (center of the text)
options.squash: Initial vertical multiplier that unfolds while rising, default 1 — brand .85 (axis is origin, default top left)
options.jitter: Each row unwinds from a random tilt within ± this angle (deg) to 0, default 0 — Brand 2
options.skew: Angle at which it rises tilted (skewY degrees), default 0 — Brand word 10. The axis is the center (if origin is given, that is used)
